claims.claim: ACoS = ad spend / attributed sales; ROAS = sales / spend; break-even ACoS is net contribution margin.
claims.interpretation: Domain-specific implementation premise; jurisdiction and product variations acknowledged

claims.claim: Attributed sales are not incremental sales. Product margin must exclude fees entered separately; otherwise costs are counted twice. No causal profit attribution.
